item.title: Vidalux 6 Oct · October sale
item.description: On now this October: at least 5% off our indoor saunas, and some models carry 10% off. Whether you're after a compact one-person cabin for a spare room or something built for the whole family, it's a good moment to look through the collection and see which one fits your space. Every model is freestanding, so it's a case of choosing the size and finish that works for your home, rather than fitting your home around the sauna. Link in comments.

item.title: Vidalux 7 Oct · FAQ carousel plug-in
item.description:
Can I just plug my infrared sauna in?
For most of our infrared saunas, yes. The 1-3 Person Solara, Solara 4 Person Corner, Premier (up to 3 Person) and Platinum (1-4 Person) all run from a standard 3-pin socket. No electrician needed, just a socket, and each one is controlled from the cabin's own panel.
The rest are wired in. Larger infrared, traditional, hybrid and outdoor saunas are connected by a Part P certified electrician. One to watch: the Solara 4 Person Corner plugs in, while the 4 Person Solara is wired in.
Swipe through for the full list, and have a look at the plug-and-play range. Link in the comments.

item.title: 10% off every sauna, all August
item.description:
August is decision month if a home sauna's been on the list for a while.
Every sauna in the range is 10% off through August... infrared, traditional, hybrid, indoor and outdoor. Applied automatically at checkout, no code, no minimum spend.
Sale runs to 31 August, then it's back to full price.

item.title: Solara 2 Person... Complete Heat, done properly
item.description:
If you want one sauna to look at this August, make it the Solara 2 Person Full Spectrum Infrared. Complete Heat Technology gives you near, mid and far infrared in the one cabin, rather than making you pick which one you want.
Soft-touch digital control panel, chromotherapy starlight, and it's 10% off through August like the rest of the range, applied automatically at checkout.
Fits two comfortably, built for daily use, not just the odd weekend.

item.title: 10% off whirlpool and airspa baths, all August
item.description:
The whirlpool and airspa range is also 10% off for August... every model, not a shortlist.
Discount comes off automatically at checkout, so there's no code to remember and no minimum spend to hit. Sale runs to 31 August.
Two separate systems in most models: whirlpool jets for deep, targeted pressure, airspa for something lighter and bubblier. Worth knowing which one you'll reach for most.
